caption: The drawing depicts a single doll positioned centrally against a plain, beige background. The doll has a pale complexion with rosy cheeks, blonde curly hair, and blue eyes. It is wearing a blue and white striped hat with a pink ribbon tied into a bow on top. The outfit consists of a beige dress with full sleeves and a white apron that covers the front, tied around the waist. The collar is decorated with a yellow ribbon and a black necklace. The lower edge of the dress and the visible underskirt are adorned with intricate lace patterns. The doll is also wearing red gloves and red shoes, both gloved hands resting by its sides. The entire figure is rendered with fine detail and subtle shading, emphasizing the texture of the clothing and accessories.
title: Doll with China Head
